cases.description: New example module consumes the api through the sanctioned top-level exports (from structurizr import StructurizrClient, StructurizrClientSettings), mirroring the committed examples/upload_workspace.py:25 pattern

diff.append:
"""Example using the sanctioned top-level public interface (new code)."""
from structurizr import StructurizrClient, StructurizrClientSettings


def upload(workspace):
    """Upload a workspace through the top-level exports (new code)."""
    settings = StructurizrClientSettings()
    client = StructurizrClient(settings=settings)
    return client.put_workspace(workspace)

cases.grading_note: No violation beyond baseline (baseline at the pin is empty): the import target is the top-level 'structurizr' package, which the ADR-0008 object pattern (structurizr.api.*) does not cover; this is the discriminating counterpart to struct-bench-example-deep-import (same added-example shape, the import depth alone flips the prohibits from fire to satisfied). If a future change broadened the object pattern to the whole structurizr.* tree, this probe would flip to a fire and catch the over-broadening; that reading was deliberately rejected in the gold note (the top level does not re-export model/view, so a whole-tree prohibition would indict the repo's own working examples). ADR-0009 stays quiet: the added example is outside its subject (src.structurizr.api.*).
